item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 17/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring a few showers to the northern part of the South China Sea. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China during the weekend, it will be windy and generally fine over the coastal areas early next week. Under the influence of a dry replenishment of the monsoon, it will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
